def {{fn_name}}(heights):
    stack = []
    best = 0
    heights = heights + [0]
    for i, h in enumerate(heights):
        while stack and heights[stack[-1]] > h:
            top = stack.pop()
            left = stack[-1] if stack else -1
            best = max(best, heights[top] * (i - left - 1))
        stack.append(i)
    return best
